commits.summary: Check JDK range fill and its caller frame (verification pending)
commits.body:

Bind the caller and callee separately and prove the observed value for shared and independently sized roots. Rebound controls distinguish missing writes, the wrong cell value, invalid empty-range handling and observing the wrong root.

commits.summary: Record the independently witnessed historical frame failures
commits.body:
The historical Guava input-heap and JDK caller-read obligations remained SAT at the same concrete inputs that the independent bytecode checker and JVM refuted. Both original, digest-bound query scopes became UNSAT on their benign controls. Historical dispositions remain unresolved, and the behavior of a deliberately faulted historical producer remains unmeasured.

The separate clean job reproduced all 14 range outcomes and both fixed-input solver comparisons. The evidence table checks 111 keyed outcomes and 142 pinned files across all 11 passing jobs. Checked the table under two hash seeds, verified all local decision links, validated the pipeline and passed all five selected test groups including 59 Rust test binaries.
